name: Zhefu Holding Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhefu Holding Group Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells clean energy equipment in China and internationally. The company offers hydroelectric turbine, tidal stream, and pumped storage generator sets, as well as pumps; and nuclear power equipment, including control rod drive mechanism, nuclear class pressure vessel and equipment, liquid metal reactor main pump, small reactor components, electromagnetic pump of a liquid metal cooled reactor, liquid-metal pump. rim-driven propeller, and non-standard equipment.
